set.wolText:
To turn your PC on from the phone:
1. BIOS: enable "Power On By PCI-E" / "Wake on LAN" and disable ErP.
2. Windows: Device Manager → network adapter → Power Management: allow this device to wake the computer + only allow a magic packet. Advanced tab: Wake on Magic Packet = Enabled.
3. Turn off Fast Startup (Control Panel → Power Options → Choose what the power buttons do).
4. Use Ethernet — most Wi-Fi cards can't wake a desktop.
